title: Constructible sheaf of modules on the pro-etale site
statement:
Let $Y$ be a scheme and let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring (for instance $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]). Let $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ be the small pro-etale site of $Y$ and $\Lambda_Y$ the constant sheaf of rings on it, and let $\mathcal F$ be a sheaf of $\Lambda_Y$-modules on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. The sheaf $\mathcal F$ is *constructible* if there exist an integer $N\geq1$ and a finite partition $Y= igsqcup_{
u=1}^{N}Y_
u$ of the underlying set of $Y$ into pairwise disjoint locally closed [def-weil-locally-closed-subset] constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset] subsets, each $Y_
u$ given a subscheme structure with immersion $i_
u:Y_
u	o Y$ (a stratification [def-constructible-stratification]), such that for every $
u$ the restriction $\mathcal F|_{Y_
u}=i_
u^{*}\mathcal F$, where the module inverse image along $i_
u$ on pro-etale sites uses the canonical identification $i_
u^{-1}\Lambda_Y\cong\Lambda_{Y_
u}$ of constant ring sheaves [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], is a locally constant sheaf of $\Lambda_{Y_
u}$-modules on $(Y_
u)_{\mathrm{proet}}$ (there is a covering $\{U_j	o Y_
u\}$ in $(Y_
u)_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and $\Lambda$-modules $M_j$ with $i_
u^*\mathcal F|_{U_j}$ isomorphic to the constant sheaf of $M_j$ [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf]) whose stalk [def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk] at every geometric point of $Y_
u$ is a finite $\Lambda$-module (finitely generated, equivalently finite as a set since $\Lambda$ is finite).
